==The triple question of Sunhair's names==

First of all, I consider it probable that men and women were allowed to choose who would take the surname of the other upon marrying. A patriarchal system seems far too off the gender equality that otherwise ruled in the Age of Legends and is only slightly flawed in the Third Age.

Secondly, I believe that Dalisar must have been Ilyena's original surname and not third name. If I married in the Age of Legends, I think I'd rather take the name of my spouse and keep my coveted third name, don't you agree? So Dalisar must have been Ilyena's second name, and Moerelle her coveted third. How this can be I am unsure of; however, it has never been proved that it isn't Damendar in Nemene Damendar Boann that was Semirhage's third name, nor that Bel in Barid Bel Medar wasn't Demandred's third. This would make more sense, I think, if the coveted third name was infused between the first and second names and moved to the back of the line upon marrying.

And finally, how about this theory: Ilyena earned her third name for her skill in making people feel welcome and converse them. Just your thoughts.
